package course_test

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	coursehttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/course"
)

func TestClientReadsStrictCanonicalLessonContext(t *testing.T) {
	lessonID := "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
	courseID := "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
	sectionID := "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/lesson/"+lessonID+"/teacher-context", request.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "ru", request.URL.Query().Get("language"))
		require.Equal(t, "course-token", request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"lesson_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","course_id":"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
			"section_id":"bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb",
			"language":"ru","title":"Ошибки","excerpt":"Кратко","description":"errors.Is(err, target)",
			"content_revision":"2026-08-31T15:00:00+03:00"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := coursehttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "course-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	content, err := client.GetLessonContext(context.Background(), lessonID, "RU")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "2026-08-31T12:00:00Z", content.ContentRevision)
	require.Equal(t, courseID, content.CourseID)
	require.Equal(t, sectionID, content.SectionID)
	require.Equal(t, "errors.Is(err, target)", content.Description)
}

func TestClientFailsClosedOnUnknownCourseFields(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"unexpected":true}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := coursehttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "course-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.GetLessonContext(
		context.Background(), "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", "ru",
	)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable)
}

func TestClientFailsClosedOnInvalidCourseIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"lesson_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","course_id":"not-a-course","section_id":"",
			"language":"ru","title":"Ошибки","excerpt":"Кратко","description":"Описание",
			"content_revision":"2026-08-31T12:00:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := coursehttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "course-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	_, err := client.GetLessonContext(
		context.Background(), "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", "ru",
	)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable)
}
